Pin Visuals bundles the following mods unchanged (Fabric jar-in-jar, META-INF/jars/).
They are separate programs and keep their own licenses:

Skyboxify 3.4 (OptiFine-format skies for Fabric)
  Authors: lowercasebtw, FlashyReese, AMereBagatelle
  License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0.txt)
  Source:  https://github.com/Legacy-Visuals-Project/Skyboxify
  Builds:  https://modrinth.com/mod/skyboxify

YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) v3, required by Skyboxify
  Author:  isXander
  License: GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0 or later (LGPL-3.0.txt, together with GPL-3.0.txt)
  Source:  https://github.com/isXander/YetAnotherConfigLib
  Builds:  https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl

The source code of exactly these versions is available at the links above (release tags of the
version numbers in the bundled file names).

Nunito (menu font, assets/texturestudio/font/nunito.ttf): Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors
(https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito), SIL Open Font License 1.1, see fonts/OFL_nunito.txt.
